This yields the SMILES: Clc1ccccc1O=[N+]([O-])c1ccccc1COC(=O). This string represents a chlorobenzene attached to a nitro‑substituted benzene which is further linked to a methoxy carbonyl group, matching the fragments supplied.</thought>
<final_answer>Clc1ccccc1O=[N+]([O-])c1ccccc1COC(=O)</final_answer>
